prompt:
POLISH THE USER'S DOODLE. Do not replace it with a generic object.
Edit the provided doodle image into a single centered sticker on a transparent background.
Style: plush. stuffed plush toy with a soft fiber pile and a tactile stitched feel. Puffy but clearly fabric, not smooth clay and not plastic.

Hard preserve constraints:
- Keep the subject identity implied by the doodle and the semantic blueprint.
- Keep the silhouette, major part count, and part placement.
- Keep distinctive proportions and the user's asymmetry. Do not mirror.
- Do not remove a meaningful doodle feature.
- Do not add arbitrary decoration, text, a background scene, a ground plane, or a drop shadow.
- Do not invent a face, eyes, or a mouth unless the blueprint says those strokes exist.
- If confidence is LOW, only clean up the existing strokes. Do not decide they are a star, animal, or any other object.

Semantic blueprint:
subject_hypothesis: teddy
confidence: HIGH
orientation: upright
components:
- body (body): role=body strokes=body
- head (head): role=head strokes=head
- ear_l (left ear): role=ear strokes=ear_l
- ear_r (right ear): role=ear strokes=ear_r
- eye_l (left eye): role=eye strokes=eye_l
- eye_r (right eye): role=eye strokes=eye_r
relationships:
- above: head -> body. head overlaps the body but stays a separate mesh
- sits_on: ear_l -> head. left ear is not fused into the skull
- sits_on: ear_r -> head. right ear is not fused into the skull
- on_face: eye_l -> head. user-drawn eye, proud of the face
- on_face: eye_r -> head. user-drawn eye, proud of the face
features_must_preserve:
- round head
- larger body under the head
- left ear, separate from the head
- right ear, separate from the head
- two eyes, count and rough placement
- no extra face parts beyond what was drawn
features_may_complete:
- soften silhouette wobble
- puff each part on its own
features_must_never_invent:
- fuse ears into the head
- invent a snout, nose, mouth, or smile
- invent a bow, belly badge, or clothing
- replace with a generic teddy render
- drop either eye
